functions.name: generate_tarot_reading
functions.title: Generate Tarot Reading
functions.description: Asks the Oracle for a full tarot reading. Provide the seeker's question, the spread (name and description), and the drawn cards (each with name, upright/reversed state, and spread position; optional clarifier cards with name and reversed flag). The deck defaults to Rider-Waite when deck is omitted. Returns the Oracle's full reading as formatted markdown text.

question.description: The seeker's question for the Oracle.

deck.description: The tarot deck used, e.g. { "name": "Rider-Waite", "tradition": "Rider-Waite-Smith" }. Optional.

spread.description: The spread being read, e.g. { "name": "Three Card", "description": "Past, present, future" }.

cards.description: The drawn cards in spread order. Each card: name, reversed (boolean), position (its spread position), and optional clarifiers (array of { name, reversed }).
